content.title: Self-Ruqyah for Protection from the Evil Eye and Black Magic: A Sunnah-Based Remedy
content.subtitle: How to Perform Ruqyah Using the Muslims Day App.
content.body:
Sudden conflicts at home without any apparent reason, unexplained setbacks at work, or prolonged illnesses with no clear medical cause are not uncommon experiences in our daily lives. In Islam, the evil eye (Ayn), black magic (Sihr), and other forms of harmful sorcery are recognised realities. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

“The evil eye is real. If anything could overtake divine decree, it would be the evil eye.” (Sahih Muslim)

However, there is no need to turn to fraudulent spiritual healers or questionable rituals for protection against such harm. The Sunnah teaches us Self-Ruqyah, the prescribed method of seeking healing through verses from the Qur’an and authentic supplications.

Ruqyah Shar'iyyah in the Light of the Qur’an and Hadith

Allah Almighty says in the Holy Qur’an:

“And We send down of the Qur’an that which is a healing and a mercy for the believers.” (Surah Al-Isra: 82)

Whenever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ fell ill or sought protection for his family, he would regularly recite Surah Al-Fatihah, Ayatul Kursi, and Surah Al-Falaq and An-Nas (Al-Mu‘awwidhatayn), then blow gently over himself or his family. Reciting these verses and supplications while placing complete trust in Allah, following the authentic Sunnah, is one of the greatest means of seeking protection from unseen harm.

An Easy Solution for Your Busy Life: Self-Ruqyah on the App

Amid our busy daily routines, many of us may know the verses and methods of Ruqyah but struggle to find time to practise them regularly. Others may find it difficult to recite while unwell or during a busy commute.

Keeping these practical challenges in mind, we introduced a dedicated Ruqyah section in the Muslims Day app, allowing you to listen to or recite Ruqyah with just one tap, even on your busiest days.

How to Use the Ruqyah Feature in the Muslims Day App

For your convenience, the app offers two separate sections: Ruqyah Audio and Ruqyah Text.

1. How to Access the Ruqyah Section:

  • Open the Muslims Day app and tap on 'Tools' from the home screen.

  • From the Tools menu, tap the 'Ruqyah' icon to access the main Ruqyah interface.

2. Ruqyah Audio (Listening and Offline Playback):

  • If you are unable to recite yourself or find it difficult due to illness, go to the 'Ruqyah Audio' section.

  • Here, you will find separate audio files organised by category, including Evil Eye, Magic and Jinn (Sihr-Mass), Ayatul Haraq, and Jinn Affliction.

  • Tap the play button on any audio file. It will automatically download and begin playing.

  • Once downloaded, you can listen to the audio anytime, completely offline, without an internet connection.

3. Ruqyah Text (Recitation and Practice):

  • If you prefer to recite the verses yourself, tap the 'Ruqyah Text' option on the right side of the interface.

  • Here, you will find the essential Qur’anic verses related to Ruqyah.
